_note: Local-style feedback lines. Kind, clean, pidgin as affection. Edit freely. The app never repeats the same line twice in a row.
right: Right on, braddah. Right on, sistah.

wrong: Close, but not yet. Read the explanation.
Small kine off. Look at the distractor.
Shoots. Da test does that on purpose.
Stay cool. The error log remembers so you don't have to.

streak.5: Five in a row. Chee hoo!

timeout: Time. No shame, that's what Blitz is for.

blitz_end: Round pau. Check your high score.
